p.s: It 's a difficult question, but I disagree the idea of traveling in a group led by a tour guide.
There are two reasons that I disagree with this idea.
If I go to England by the package tour, I would have to pay a lot of money.
Maybe I will need pay 200,000 yen at least in case of staying London in three days.
Someone think that paying a lot of money for trip is nutural, because we buy the safty at the same time.
However, I 'm a student now and I ca n't earn a lot of money, so I will go on a trip by myself.
In Feburary, I went to England with my friends.
I bought bording pass by myself and l also booked the hotel by internet by my self.
It 's easy for me to make a contract.
Second reason is about the time.
If I go on a trip led by a tour guide, I would be able to go to some famous place of sightseeing.
However, I must keep the time.
I heard that there is n't enough time to enjoy looking at the famous place.
It means that I have to hurry to do something, but I do n't need to hurry if I go on a trip by myself.
I can enjoy looking the tourist attractions, looking around the shop, eating something until my stomach filled.
For these reasons, I disagree with the idea of traveling with a lot of peple led by tour guide.
